targets.rawSql: WITH alias AS (SELECT country_code FROM weather.entsoe_country_aliases WHERE entsoe_area_name = '$Country' LIMIT 1) SELECT now() AS time, ROUND(AVG(temperature_2m_c)::numeric, 1) AS value FROM weather.latest_country_hourly_forecast WHERE country_code = (SELECT country_code FROM alias) AND forecast_time BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '24 hours'

SELECT now() AS time, ROUND(AVG("Price[Currency/MWh]")::numeric, 2) AS value FROM entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND (TRIM(COALESCE("Sequence", '')) = '' OR "Sequence" = '1') AND "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '24 hours'

WITH alias AS (SELECT country_code FROM weather.entsoe_country_aliases WHERE entsoe_area_name = '$Country' LIMIT 1) SELECT now() AS time, ROUND(MAX(100 * renewables_weather_index)::numeric, 1) AS value FROM weather.latest_country_hourly_forecast WHERE country_code = (SELECT country_code FROM alias) AND forecast_time BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '24 hours'

WITH alias AS (SELECT country_code FROM weather.entsoe_country_aliases WHERE entsoe_area_name = '$Country' LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM (SELECT forecast_time AS time, 'Temperature C' AS metric, temperature_2m_c AS value FROM weather.latest_country_hourly_forecast WHERE country_code = (SELECT country_code FROM alias) AND forecast_time BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) UNION ALL SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS time, 'Load Forecast MW' AS metric, "TotalLoad[MW]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."DayAheadTotalLoadForecast" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0)) s ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH alias AS (SELECT country_code FROM weather.entsoe_country_aliases WHERE entsoe_area_name = '$Country' LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM (SELECT forecast_time AS time, 'Wind Proxy %' AS metric, 100 * wind_generation_index AS value FROM weather.latest_country_hourly_forecast WHERE country_code = (SELECT country_code FROM alias) AND forecast_time BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) UNION ALL SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS time, 'Wind Forecast MW' AS metric, SUM("CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]") AS value FROM entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "ProductionType" IN ('Wind Onshore', 'Wind Offshore') AND "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) GROUP BY 1) s ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH alias AS (SELECT country_code FROM weather.entsoe_country_aliases WHERE entsoe_area_name = '$Country' LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM (SELECT forecast_time AS time, 'Solar Proxy %' AS metric, 100 * solar_generation_index AS value FROM weather.latest_country_hourly_forecast WHERE country_code = (SELECT country_code FROM alias) AND forecast_time BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) UNION ALL SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS time, 'Solar Forecast MW' AS metric, SUM("CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]") AS value FROM entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "ProductionType" = 'Solar' AND "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) GROUP BY 1) s ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH alias AS (SELECT country_code FROM weather.entsoe_country_aliases WHERE entsoe_area_name = '$Country' LIMIT 1) SELECT * FROM (SELECT forecast_time AS time, 'Renewables Weather %' AS metric, 100 * renewables_weather_index AS value FROM weather.latest_country_hourly_forecast WHERE country_code = (SELECT country_code FROM alias) AND forecast_time BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) UNION ALL SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS time, 'Day-ahead Price' AS metric, "Price[Currency/MWh]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND (TRIM(COALESCE("Sequence", '')) = '' OR "Sequence" = '1') AND "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0)) s ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH alias AS (SELECT country_code FROM weather.entsoe_country_aliases WHERE entsoe_area_name = '$Country' LIMIT 1), wx AS (SELECT forecast_time, ROUND(temperature_2m_c::numeric, 1) AS temperature_c, ROUND(wind_speed_80m_ms::numeric, 1) AS wind_80m_ms, ROUND(shortwave_radiation_wm2::numeric, 0) AS shortwave_radiation_wm2, ROUND((100 * renewables_weather_index)::numeric, 1) AS renewables_weather_pct FROM weather.latest_country_hourly_forecast WHERE country_code = (SELECT country_code FROM alias) AND forecast_time BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '24 hours'), load_fc AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS forecast_time, ROUND("TotalLoad[MW]"::numeric, 1) AS load_forecast_mw FROM entsoe_fms."DayAheadTotalLoadForecast" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '24 hours'), wind_fc AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS forecast_time, ROUND(SUM("CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]")::numeric, 1) AS wind_forecast_mw FROM entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "ProductionType" IN ('Wind Onshore', 'Wind Offshore') AND "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1), solar_fc AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS forecast_time, ROUND(SUM("CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]")::numeric, 1) AS solar_forecast_mw FROM entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "ProductionType" = 'Solar' AND "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1), prices AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS forecast_time, ROUND("Price[Currency/MWh]"::numeric, 2) AS price_eur_mwh FROM entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND (TRIM(COALESCE("Sequence", '')) = '' OR "Sequence" = '1') AND "DateTime(UTC)" BETWEEN now() AND now() + interval '24 hours') SELECT wx.forecast_time, wx.temperature_c, wx.wind_80m_ms, wx.shortwave_radiation_wm2, wx.renewables_weather_pct, load_fc.load_forecast_mw, wind_fc.wind_forecast_mw, solar_fc.solar_forecast_mw, prices.price_eur_mwh FROM wx LEFT JOIN load_fc ON load_fc.forecast_time = wx.forecast_time LEFT JOIN wind_fc ON wind_fc.forecast_time = wx.forecast_time LEFT JOIN solar_fc ON solar_fc.forecast_time = wx.forecast_time LEFT JOIN prices ON prices.forecast_time = wx.forecast_time ORDER BY wx.forecast_time
